**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user is planning a trip to Japan.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is looking for affordable accommodation options.
- [PREFERENCE] The user has heard that hostels are a great way to save money but is unsure what to expect.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Staying in a hostel in Japan is a fantastic way to save money, meet fellow travelers, and experience the local culture.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Types of hostels include dormitories (shared rooms), private rooms, and capsule hotels (pod hotels).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Dormitory prices range from ¥2,000 to ¥5,000 (around $18-$45 USD) per night.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Private room prices range from ¥5,000 to ¥10,000 (around $45-$90 USD) per night.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Capsule hotels cost between ¥2,000 to ¥5,000 (around $18-$45 USD) per night.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Most hostels in Japan offer free Wi-Fi, shared kitchen facilities, lounge areas, laundry machines, lockers, and 24-hour reception.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Some hostels may provide breakfast, linens, towels, hair dryers, toiletries, and tour bookings.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Japanese hostels are known for their cleanliness and tidiness.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Noise levels are generally kept low in shared rooms, but earplugs might still be a good idea.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Some hostels may have a curfew, especially in residential areas.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It's advisable to learn basic Japanese phrases for better communication.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Some hostels may not allow guests with tattoos to use their facilities.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Booking websites include Booking.com, Hostelworld, and Japan-Guide.com.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Prices for shared rooms in hostels typically range from ¥2,000-¥5,000 (around $18-$45 USD) per night.
- [FACT] The user stayed in a hostel in Tokyo that cost around $30 per night when traveling solo last January.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is planning to visit popular tourist spots in Tokyo, such as Shibuya Crossing and Tokyo Tower.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tokyo has a comprehensive and efficient public transportation system that is relatively affordable.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Taxis are convenient but can be expensive, especially during peak hours.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended transportation options include prepaid IC cards (Suica or Pasmo), Tokyo Metro, JR Train, and Toei Bus.
